a.lede: The company’s board of directors has reinstated Huang a little more than a week after the CEO resigned amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: In the same week that NVIDIA reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO, the company has reportedly also blocked shipments to Southeast Asia.
b.title: NVIDIA reportedly halts AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia
